scientific_method.primary: clean X-VLA teacher to matched wrist-dropout X-VLA student action-semantic distillation over the full 30-step action chunk
scientific_method.auxiliary: training-only clean wrist-view Florence2 latent reconstruction from the shared dropout action-hidden trunk
scientific_method.deployment: zero-initialized action-hidden residual at model.transformer.norm; reconstruction prediction is never inserted or consumed by the policy
scientific_method.claim: deployment-clean adaptation of a frozen multi-view VLA to complete wrist loss with action-chunk hidden and continuous-action alignment, separate raw gripper-margin preservation, training-only reconstruction, exact clean bypass, and no inference teacher/retrieval/generator/reconstructed input

exact_frozen_scope.student_backbone: all official X-VLA parameters including VLM, transformer blocks, norm, projections, prompts, action encoder, and action decoder

losses.normalization: fixed discovery Base-dropout-versus-clean-teacher denominators, mechanically frozen before training
losses.clean_identity_loss: architectural exact bypass rather than an approximate penalty

training_arms: NO_RECONSTRUCTION with matched teacher distillation and capacity
NO_RAW_GRIPPER_MARGIN with remaining objectives and matched capacity
GENERIC_WRIST_DROPOUT_ADAPTER with ordinary demonstration supervision and matched capacity/data/budget

comparator_roles.BASE: frozen official X-VLA under wrist dropout

stage0_data.discovery: three frozen tasks, demos 0..39, official-reader positions 0,9,18,27
stage0_data.validation: three frozen tasks, demo 40, official-reader positions 0,9,18,27
stage0_data.fixed_confirmation_reserve: demos 41..49, inaccessible unless the frozen decision authorizes one confirmation/expansion

training_budget.schedule: 8-step linear warmup then cosine decay to 0.00003

practical_effect_rule.absolute_threshold: max(per-metric frozen floor, 10 times measured repeated-forward numerical noise)
practical_effect_rule.full_vs_no_reconstruction: must improve at least one co-primary teacher-agreement metric with no material regression on the others and no added gripper disagreement
practical_effect_rule.full_vs_generic: must improve at least one co-primary metric or classify STAGE0_GENERIC_ADAPTATION_EXPLAINS_GAIN
practical_effect_rule.reconstruction: full MSE at most 0.95 times no-reconstruction overall and lower on at least two tasks

simulation_only_calibration.claim: ROBUST VLA MANIPULATION UNDER SIMULATED WRIST-CAMERA FAILURES
simulation_only_calibration.stage_a: three tasks x three identities initially; one conditional expansion to five
simulation_only_calibration.stage_b: at least four tasks and three wrist-failure conditions; 60 paired failure rows initially, one boundary-triggered expansion to 80
simulation_only_calibration.pareto: performance advantage, one major structural advantage with noninferior success, or two moderate advantages with noninferior success

latency_and_memory.timing: 10 warmup plus 100 measured fixed-input queries; total and adapter-only median/p95/mean
latency_and_memory.pareto_effect_thresholds_frozen_at: separate Stage A manifest before outcomes

validated: reconstruction prediction not consumed by action residual

pre_execution_specification_erratum.actual_condition: processor-equivalent black wrist pixels with unchanged official image_mask [true,true,false] and missing_indicator=1
